record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set learning rate to 7e-4, dropout to 0.3 and weight decay to 1e-5. Smaller updates and stronger regularization may complement normalized tied embeddings and the narrower feed-forward layers; this uses a less aggressive learning-rate reduction than the earlier modestly successful tuning trial. Keep width 64, two blocks, two heads, history length 128, batch size 128 and Adam. Preserve all formulas, seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, couple a lower learning rate of 7e-4 with dropout 0.3 and weight decay 1e-5 to moderate updates and regularize the normalized tied embeddings and narrower feed-forward layers. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction remain compatible. Preserve all other hyperparameters, formulas, seeds and training limits.
